# ---- the probe (P1) ----------------------------------------------------------------

def run_probe(sources=ROOT / SOURCES):
    import reference_build
    import swift_build
    out = WORK / ("probe" if Path(sources).resolve() == (ROOT / SOURCES).resolve()
                  else "probe-mutant")
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    entry = out / "main.swift"
    text = (HERE / "vp9_rate_probe.swift").read_text()
    if not entry.exists() or entry.read_text() != text:
        entry.write_text(text)
    binary, answer = out / "vp9-rate-probe", out / "answer.json"
    defines = reference_build.tree_defines(Path(sources).parent.parent, ["FRAMEJOB_DEV_TOOLS"])
    try:
        built = swift_build.build(sources=swift_build.app_sources(sources) + [entry],
                                  output=binary, defines=defines)
        if not built.reused:
            print(f"probe built in {built.seconds:.0f} s", flush=True)
    except swift_build.SwiftBuildFailed as error:
        lines = [line for line in error.diagnostics if ": error:" in line]
        return check("P1", False, "the probe did not build: "
                     + " | ".join(lines[:3] or list(error.diagnostics[:3]) or [str(error)]))
    points = sorted(set(SVT_EXPECTED) | set(VP9_EXPECTED))
    answer.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    ran = bounded.run([str(binary), str(answer), *map(str, points)], 120)
    if ran["expired"] or ran["rc"] != 0 or not answer.exists():
        return check("P1", False, "the probe did not run: "
                     + (ran["stdout"] + ran["stderr"]).strip()[-300:])
    got = json.loads(answer.read_text())
    misses = []
    for k, bpp in enumerate(points):
        if bpp in SVT_EXPECTED:
            seen = tuple(got["svt"][s][k] for s in ("faster", "balanced", "smaller"))
            if seen != SVT_EXPECTED[bpp]:
                misses.append(f"SVT at {bpp}: {seen} (want {SVT_EXPECTED[bpp]})")
        if bpp in VP9_EXPECTED:
            seen = tuple(got["vp9"][d][k] for d in ("8", "10"))
            if seen != VP9_EXPECTED[bpp]:
                misses.append(f"VP9 at {bpp}: {seen} (want {VP9_EXPECTED[bpp]})")
    check("P1", not misses, f"{len(SVT_EXPECTED)} SVT and {len(VP9_EXPECTED)} VP9 points; "
          + (f"misses {misses}" if misses else "every value the table's"))


# ---- the rate (R1–R3) --------------------------------------------------------------

def run_r_rows(app, logs):
    if not av1.OWNER.exists():
        for ident in ("R1", "R2", "R3"):
            print(f"{ident} skipped — the owner's fixture {av1.OWNER} is not here", flush=True)
        return
    out = WORK / "rate"
    av1.tree_copy.remove_tree(str(out))
    out.mkdir(parents=True)
    instance = av1.Instance("r", app)
    logs.append(instance)
    pixels = 1920 * 1080 * 30
    high = max(100_000, round(pixels * 0.129 * 0.6 / 100_000) * 100_000)
    cases = {"R1": (False, None, round(pixels * 0.07)), "R2": (False, high, high),
             "R3": (True, None, round(pixels * 0.07))}
    try:
        if instance.client is None:
            for ident in cases:
                check(ident, False, "the app did not listen")
            return
        for hdr in (False, True):
            doc = av1.Doc(instance, f"rate-{'hlg' if hdr else 'sdr'}", 1920, 1080)
            try:
                if hdr:
                    doc.call("set_canvas", output="hlg")
                doc.call("add_clip", track=doc.track(), media=doc.media(av1.OWNER), at=0)
                pix = "yuv420p10le" if hdr else "yuv420p"
                comparator = "hevc_10bit" if hdr else "hevc"
                reference = out / f"reference-{'hlg' if hdr else 'sdr'}.mov"
                try:
                    export(doc, reference, preset="prores_422")
                except mcp.ToolError as error:
                    for ident, case in cases.items():
                        if case[0] == hdr:
                            check(ident, False, f"the ProRes 422 reference failed: {error}")
                    continue
                for ident, (case_hdr, asked, cap) in cases.items():
                    if case_hdr != hdr:
                        continue
                    extra = {"video_bitrate": asked} if asked else {}
                    theirs = out / f"{ident}-{comparator}.mp4"
                    ours = out / f"{ident}-vp9.webm"
                    try:
                        export(doc, theirs, preset=comparator, **extra)
                        started = time.monotonic()
                        export(doc, ours, **extra)
                        took = time.monotonic() - started
                    except mcp.ToolError as error:
                        check(ident, False, f"an export failed: {error}")
                        continue
                    floor = vmaf(theirs, reference, out / f"{ident}-{comparator}.json", pix)
                    score = vmaf(ours, reference, out / f"{ident}-vp9.json", pix)
                    rate = video_rate(ours)
                    ok = (floor is not None and score is not None and score >= floor
                          and 0 < rate <= CAP_TOLERANCE * cap)
                    check(ident, ok, f"cap {cap} b/s ({'video_bitrate ' + str(asked) if asked else 'Format default'}"
                          f"{', hlg' if hdr else ''}); {comparator} "
                          f"{int(av1.video_stream(theirs).get('bit_rate') or 0)} b/s, VMAF "
                          f"{floor if floor is None else round(floor, 3)}; vp9_webm {rate} b/s "
                          f"({rate / cap:.3f} of the cap, ≤ {CAP_TOLERANCE}), VMAF "
                          f"{score if score is None else round(score, 3)} ({pix}), {took:.1f} s")
            finally:
                doc.close()
    finally:
        instance.stop()


# ---- the mutants -------------------------------------------------------------------

def run_mutant(name):
    if name not in MUTANTS:
        print(f"unknown mutant {name}; the mutants are {sorted(MUTANTS)}")
        return 2
    mutant = MUTANTS[name]
    named = list(mutant["rows"])
    print(f"mutant {name}: building the copy", flush=True)
    av1.MUTANTS = MUTANTS
    app, copy = av1.build_mutant(name)
    if app is None:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {copy}")
        return 2
    cargo = mutant.get("cargo")
    if cargo:
        ran = bounded.run(["cargo", "test", "--release", "--no-fail-fast", "--test", cargo],
                          1200, cwd=str(copy / "core"))
        out = ran["stdout"] + ran["stderr"]
        if ran["expired"] or "test result:" not in out:
            print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — cargo rc {ran['rc']}: "
                  f"{out[-600:]}")
            return 2
        failed = re.findall(r"^test (\w+) \.\.\. FAILED$", out, re.M)
        check(f"cargo-{cargo}", ran["rc"] == 0, f"failed tests {failed}")
        named.append(f"cargo-{cargo}")
    logs = []
    try:
        run_rows(app, logs, probe=False)
    except Exception as error:  # an instrument that cannot run is the control's failure
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {error}")
        return 2
    failing = sorted(k for k, v in results.items() if not v)
    print(f"mutant {name}: named {sorted(named)}, failing {failing}")
    if sorted(named) == failing:
        print(f"MUTANT CAUGHT: {name}")
        return 1
    if not set(named) & set(failing):
        print(f"MUTANT SURVIVED: {name}")
        return 0
    print(f"MUTANT CAUGHT, NOT EXACTLY: {name}")
    return 3


# ---- main --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def run_rows(app, logs, rate=False, probe=True):
    run_v_rows(app, logs)
    run_s1(app, logs)
    if probe:
        run_probe()
    if rate:
        run_r_rows(app, logs)
    found = [(i.label, line) for i in logs for line in i.complaints()]
    check("Z1", not found, f"{len(logs)} instance logs; complaints {found[:4]}")


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="the vp9_webm row (codec-export C4)")
    parser.add_argument("--app", help="debug, release or a .app path (default RC_PROOF_APP)")
    parser.add_argument("--rate", action="store_true", help="also R1–R3 (CX-16 (7))")
    parser.add_argument("--probe", action="store_true", help="P1 alone, no app")
    parser.add_argument("--mutant", help="one of " + ", ".join(MUTANTS))
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.app:
        os.environ[proof_app.ENV] = args.app
    WORK.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if args.mutant:
        return run_mutant(args.mutant)
    if args.probe:
        run_probe()
        print(f"scores: {sum(results.values())}/{len(results)}")
        return 0 if all(results.values()) else 1
    logs = []
    try:
        app = proof_app.bundle()

def row_v8(doc, out):
    lines, misses, hlg_path = [], [], None
    mastering = {"max_luminance": "1000/1", "min_luminance": "1/200", "red_x": "17/25",
                 "red_y": "8/25", "green_x": "53/200", "green_y": "69/100", "blue_x": "3/20",
                 "blue_y": "3/50", "white_point_x": "3127/10000", "white_point_y": "329/1000"}
    for asked, cicp, bits, profile, pix, tags, space, hdr10 in [
            (None, (9, 18, 9), 10, "Profile 2", "yuv420p10le", "bt2020nc/arib-std-b67/bt2020",
             5, False),
            ("pq", (9, 16, 9), 10, "Profile 2", "yuv420p10le", "bt2020nc/smpte2084/bt2020",
             5, True),
            ("sdr", (1, 1, 1), 8, "Profile 0", "yuv420p", "bt709/bt709/bt709", 2, False)]:
        want = asked or "hlg"
        path = out / f"v8-{want}.webm"
        try:
            done = export(doc, path, **({} if asked is None else {"dynamic_range": asked}))
        except mcp.ToolError as error:
            misses.append(f"{want}: {error}")
            continue
        if want == "hlg":
            hlg_path = path
        seen_pix, seen_profile, seen_tags = av1.colour_tags(path)
        spaces, ranges = trace_colour(path)
        _, _, colour = video_entry(path)
        stream = av1.stream_side(path)
        kinds = set(stream[1]) if stream else None
        want_colour = {"matrix": cicp[2], "bits": bits, "range": 1, "transfer": cicp[1],
                       "primaries": cicp[0], "mastering": hdr10}
        if hdr10:
            want_colour.update({"max_cll": 1000, "max_fall": 0})
        row = []
        if done.get("dynamic_range") != want:
            row.append(f"answer {done.get('dynamic_range')!r}")
        if (seen_pix, seen_profile, seen_tags) != (pix, profile, tags):
            row.append(f"read {seen_pix} / {seen_profile} / {seen_tags}")
        if (spaces, ranges) != ([space], [0]):
            row.append(f"trace color_space {spaces} color_range {ranges}")
        if colour != want_colour:
            row.append(f"Colour {colour}")
        if kinds is None:
            row.append("ffprobe could not read the side data")
        elif hdr10 and ("Mastering display metadata" not in kinds
                        or {k: stream[0].get(k) for k in mastering} != mastering):
            row.append(f"side data {sorted(kinds)} {stream[0]}")
        elif not hdr10 and {"Mastering display metadata",
                            "Content light level metadata"} & kinds:
            row.append(f"side data {sorted(kinds)}")
        misses += [f"{want}: {m}" for m in row]
        lines.append(f"{want}: {seen_pix} / {seen_profile} / {seen_tags}, trace color_space "
                     f"{spaces}, Colour {colour}, side data "
                     f"{sorted(kinds) if kinds is not None else None}")
    check("V8", not misses, "; ".join(lines) + (f"; misses {misses}" if misses else ""))
    return hlg_path


def row_v9(instance, hlg, out):
    lines, ok, stripes = [], True, None
    try:
        for label in ("hlg", "pq"):
            decoded = {}
            for preset in ("vp9_webm", "hevc_10bit"):
                path = out / f"v9a-{label}-{preset}.{'webm' if preset == 'vp9_webm' else 'mp4'}"
                export(hlg, path, preset=preset, video_bitrate=PIXEL_RATE, dynamic_range=label)
                decoded[preset] = av1.decode10(path, frames=FRAMES)
            diffs = (av1.frame_differences(decoded["vp9_webm"], decoded["hevc_10bit"], 640, 360,
                                           FRAMES)
                     if decoded["vp9_webm"] and decoded["hevc_10bit"] else None)
            good = diffs is not None and all(d <= FRAME_BOUND for d in diffs)
            ok = ok and good
            lines.append(f"(a) {label}: Y/Cb/Cr " + ("decode failed" if diffs is None
                                                     else "/".join(f"{d:.3f}" for d in diffs))
                         + ("" if good else " ✗"))
        fixture = av1.stripes_fixture()
        if fixture is None:
            check("V9", False, "; ".join(lines) + "; the stripes fixture could not be made")
            return
        stripes = av1.Doc(instance, "v9-stripes")
        stripes.call("set_canvas", output="hlg")
        stripes.call("add_clip", track=stripes.track(), media=stripes.media(fixture), at=0)
        for label in ("hlg", "pq"):
            decoded = {}
            for preset in ("vp9_webm", "hevc_10bit"):
                path = out / f"v9b-{label}-{preset}.{'webm' if preset == 'vp9_webm' else 'mp4'}"
                export(stripes, path, preset=preset, video_bitrate=PIXEL_RATE,
                       dynamic_range=label)
                decoded[preset] = av1.decode10(path, index=30)
            for stripe, colour in enumerate(("red", "green", "blue")):
                means = {p: av1.patch_means(d, 640, 360, stripe) if d else None
                         for p, d in decoded.items()}
                if means["vp9_webm"] is None or means["hevc_10bit"] is None:
                    ok = False
                    lines.append(f"(b) {label} {colour}: decode failed ✗")
                    continue
                parts = []
                for plane, a, b in zip(("Y", "Cb", "Cr"), means["vp9_webm"],
                                       means["hevc_10bit"]):
                    good = abs(a - b) <= HDR_PATCH_BOUND
                    ok = ok and good
                    parts.append(f"{plane} {a:.2f}/{b:.2f} ({a - b:+.2f})"
                                 + ("" if good else " ✗"))
                lines.append(f"(b) {label} {colour}: " + ", ".join(parts))
    except (mcp.ToolError, KeyError, IndexError, OSError) as error:
        ok = False
        lines.append(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
    finally:
        if stripes is not None:
            stripes.close()
    check("V9", ok, f"vp9_webm against hevc_10bit at {PIXEL_RATE} b/s as yuv420p10le, (a) "
          f"each plane's mean absolute difference ≤ {FRAME_BOUND}, (b) patch means at frame 30 "
          f"within {HDR_PATCH_BOUND}: " + "; ".join(lines))


def row_v10(instance, source, v1, hlg_file, out):
    if v1 is None or hlg_file is None:
        return check("V10", False, f"a file to import is missing: V1 {v1}, V8's hlg {hlg_file}")
    doc, lines, ok = None, [], True
    try:
        doc = av1.Doc(instance, "v10")
        media = {}
        for label, path in (("V1", v1), ("V8 hlg", hlg_file)):
            answer = doc.call("import_media", path=str(path))
            found = next(m for m in doc.call("get_project")["project"]["media"]
                         if m["id"] == answer["media"])
            media[label] = found["id"]
            good = (abs(found["duration"] / SEC - 5) <= 1 / 30
                    and (found.get("width"), found.get("height")) == (640, 360)
                    and found.get("has_audio"))
            ok = ok and good
            lines.append(f"{label}: {found['duration'] / SEC:.3f} s "
                         f"{found.get('width')} × {found.get('height')}, audio "
                         f"{found.get('has_audio')}" + ("" if good else " ✗"))
        doc.call("add_clip", track=doc.track(), media=media["V1"], at=0)
        theirs, ours = out / "v10-source.png", out / "v10-import.png"
        source.call("render_frame", t=3 * SEC, path=str(theirs))
        doc.call("render_frame", t=3 * SEC, path=str(ours))
        a, b = rgb(theirs), rgb(ours)
        if not a or not b or len(a) != len(b):
            ok = False
            lines.append(f"the renders could not be read ({len(a or b'')}, {len(b or b'')})")
        else:
            means = [sum(abs(a[i] - b[i]) for i in range(c, len(a), 3)) / (len(a) / 3)
                     for c in range(3)]
            good = all(m <= RENDER_BOUND for m in means)
            ok = ok and good
            lines.append("render at 3 s against A1's: R/G/B "
                         + "/".join(f"{m:.3f}" for m in means) + f" (≤ {RENDER_BOUND})"
                         + ("" if good else " ✗"))
    except (mcp.ToolError, KeyError, StopIteration, OSError) as error:
        ok = False
        lines.append(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
    finally:
        if doc is not None:
            doc.close()
    check("V10", ok, "; ".join(lines))

# ---- the probe (P1) ----------------------------------------------------------------

def run_probe(sources=ROOT / SOURCES):
    import reference_build
    import swift_build
    out = WORK / ("probe" if Path(sources).resolve() == (ROOT / SOURCES).resolve()
                  else "probe-mutant")
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    entry = out / "main.swift"
    text = (HERE / "vp9_rate_probe.swift").read_text()
    if not entry.exists() or entry.read_text() != text:
        entry.write_text(text)
    binary, answer = out / "vp9-rate-probe", out / "answer.json"
    defines = reference_build.tree_defines(Path(sources).parent.parent, ["FRAMEJOB_DEV_TOOLS"])
    try:
        built = swift_build.build(sources=swift_build.app_sources(sources) + [entry],
                                  output=binary, defines=defines)
        if not built.reused:
            print(f"probe built in {built.seconds:.0f} s", flush=True)
    except swift_build.SwiftBuildFailed as error:
        lines = [line for line in error.diagnostics if ": error:" in line]
        return check("P1", False, "the probe did not build: "
                     + " | ".join(lines[:3] or list(error.diagnostics[:3]) or [str(error)]))
    points = sorted(set(SVT_EXPECTED) | set(VP9_EXPECTED))
    answer.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    ran = bounded.run([str(binary), str(answer), *map(str, points)], 120)
    if ran["expired"] or ran["rc"] != 0 or not answer.exists():
        return check("P1", False, "the probe did not run: "
                     + (ran["stdout"] + ran["stderr"]).strip()[-300:])
    got = json.loads(answer.read_text())
    misses = []
    for k, bpp in enumerate(points):
        if bpp in SVT_EXPECTED:
            seen = tuple(got["svt"][s][k] for s in ("faster", "balanced", "smaller"))
            if seen != SVT_EXPECTED[bpp]:
                misses.append(f"SVT at {bpp}: {seen} (want {SVT_EXPECTED[bpp]})")
        if bpp in VP9_EXPECTED:
            seen = tuple(got["vp9"][d][k] for d in ("8", "10"))
            if seen != VP9_EXPECTED[bpp]:
                misses.append(f"VP9 at {bpp}: {seen} (want {VP9_EXPECTED[bpp]})")
    check("P1", not misses, f"{len(SVT_EXPECTED)} SVT and {len(VP9_EXPECTED)} VP9 points; "
          + (f"misses {misses}" if misses else "every value the table's"))


# ---- the rate (R1–R3) --------------------------------------------------------------

def run_r_rows(app, logs):
    if not av1.OWNER.exists():
        for ident in ("R1", "R2", "R3"):
            print(f"{ident} skipped — the owner's fixture {av1.OWNER} is not here", flush=True)
        return
    out = WORK / "rate"
    av1.tree_copy.remove_tree(str(out))
    out.mkdir(parents=True)
    instance = av1.Instance("r", app)
    logs.append(instance)
    pixels = 1920 * 1080 * 30
    high = max(100_000, round(pixels * 0.129 * 0.6 / 100_000) * 100_000)
    cases = {"R1": (False, None, round(pixels * 0.07)), "R2": (False, high, high),
             "R3": (True, None, round(pixels * 0.07))}
    try:
        if instance.client is None:
            for ident in cases:
                check(ident, False, "the app did not listen")
            return
        for hdr in (False, True):
            doc = av1.Doc(instance, f"rate-{'hlg' if hdr else 'sdr'}", 1920, 1080)
            try:
                if hdr:
                    doc.call("set_canvas", output="hlg")
                doc.call("add_clip", track=doc.track(), media=doc.media(av1.OWNER), at=0)
                pix = "yuv420p10le" if hdr else "yuv420p"
                comparator = "hevc_10bit" if hdr else "hevc"
                reference = out / f"reference-{'hlg' if hdr else 'sdr'}.mov"
                try:
                    export(doc, reference, preset="prores_422")
                except mcp.ToolError as error:
                    for ident, case in cases.items():
                        if case[0] == hdr:
                            check(ident, False, f"the ProRes 422 reference failed: {error}")
                    continue
                for ident, (case_hdr, asked, cap) in cases.items():
                    if case_hdr != hdr:
                        continue
                    extra = {"video_bitrate": asked} if asked else {}
                    theirs = out / f"{ident}-{comparator}.mp4"
                    ours = out / f"{ident}-vp9.webm"
                    try:
                        export(doc, theirs, preset=comparator, **extra)
                        started = time.monotonic()
                        export(doc, ours, **extra)
                        took = time.monotonic() - started
                    except mcp.ToolError as error:
                        check(ident, False, f"an export failed: {error}")
                        continue
                    floor = vmaf(theirs, reference, out / f"{ident}-{comparator}.json", pix)
                    score = vmaf(ours, reference, out / f"{ident}-vp9.json", pix)
                    rate = video_rate(ours)
                    ok = (floor is not None and score is not None and score >= floor
                          and 0 < rate <= CAP_TOLERANCE * cap)
                    check(ident, ok, f"cap {cap} b/s ({'video_bitrate ' + str(asked) if asked else 'Format default'}"
                          f"{', hlg' if hdr else ''}); {comparator} "
                          f"{int(av1.video_stream(theirs).get('bit_rate') or 0)} b/s, VMAF "
                          f"{floor if floor is None else round(floor, 3)}; vp9_webm {rate} b/s "
                          f"({rate / cap:.3f} of the cap, ≤ {CAP_TOLERANCE}), VMAF "
                          f"{score if score is None else round(score, 3)} ({pix}), {took:.1f} s")
            finally:
                doc.close()
    finally:
        instance.stop()


# ---- the mutants -------------------------------------------------------------------

def run_mutant(name):
    if name not in MUTANTS:
        print(f"unknown mutant {name}; the mutants are {sorted(MUTANTS)}")
        return 2
    mutant = MUTANTS[name]
    named = list(mutant["rows"])
    print(f"mutant {name}: building the copy", flush=True)
    av1.MUTANTS = MUTANTS
    app, copy = av1.build_mutant(name)
    if app is None:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {copy}")
        return 2
    cargo = mutant.get("cargo")
    if cargo:
        ran = bounded.run(["cargo", "test", "--release", "--no-fail-fast", "--test", cargo],
                          1200, cwd=str(copy / "core"))
        out = ran["stdout"] + ran["stderr"]
        if ran["expired"] or "test result:" not in out:
            print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — cargo rc {ran['rc']}: "
                  f"{out[-600:]}")
            return 2
        failed = re.findall(r"^test (\w+) \.\.\. FAILED$", out, re.M)
        check(f"cargo-{cargo}", ran["rc"] == 0, f"failed tests {failed}")
        named.append(f"cargo-{cargo}")
    logs = []
    try:
        run_rows(app, logs, probe=False)
    except Exception as error:  # an instrument that cannot run is the control's failure
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {error}")
        return 2
    failing = sorted(k for k, v in results.items() if not v)
    print(f"mutant {name}: named {sorted(named)}, failing {failing}")
    if sorted(named) == failing:
        print(f"MUTANT CAUGHT: {name}")
        return 1
    if not set(named) & set(failing):
        print(f"MUTANT SURVIVED: {name}")
        return 0
    print(f"MUTANT CAUGHT, NOT EXACTLY: {name}")
    return 3


# ---- main --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def run_rows(app, logs, rate=False, probe=True):
    run_v_rows(app, logs)
    run_s1(app, logs)
    if probe:
        run_probe()
    if rate:
        run_r_rows(app, logs)
    found = [(i.label, line) for i in logs for line in i.complaints()]
    check("Z1", not found, f"{len(logs)} instance logs; complaints {found[:4]}")


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="the vp9_webm row (codec-export C4)")
    parser.add_argument("--app", help="debug, release or a .app path (default RC_PROOF_APP)")
    parser.add_argument("--rate", action="store_true", help="also R1–R3 (CX-16 (7))")
    parser.add_argument("--probe", action="store_true", help="P1 alone, no app")
    parser.add_argument("--mutant", help="one of " + ", ".join(MUTANTS))
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.app:
        os.environ[proof_app.ENV] = args.app
    WORK.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if args.mutant:
        return run_mutant(args.mutant)
    if args.probe:
        run_probe()
        print(f"scores: {sum(results.values())}/{len(results)}")
        return 0 if all(results.values()) else 1
    logs = []
    try:
        app = proof_app.bundle()
        proof_app.require_fresh(proof_app.executable(app))
    except (proof_app.StaleApp, ValueError, OSError) as error:
        check("V0", False, f"the app cannot be driven: {error}")
        print("scores: 0/1")
        return 1
    print(f"app {app}", flush=True)
    run_rows(app, logs, rate=args.rate)
    passed = sum(results.values())
    print(f"scores: {passed}/{len(results)}")
    return 0 if all(results.values()) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

content.content:
+ "The export_id lasts until Frame Job quits. Every refusal comes back "
                    + "from this call, before anything is queued: a bad argument, a missing "
                    + "folder, and a graphic clip whose module does not compile; a failure "
                    + "while writing comes back from export_status, failed with its reason "
                    + "(a graphic that fails during the export stops it with no file left, "
                    + "naming the graphic and the frame). The preset is the ENCODING only and "
                    + "the size a separate choice defaulting to the document's own, or on gif "
                    + "and apng to the format's cap; the core resolves both into concrete "
                    + "settings (container, codec, size, rate, range) and hands them to the "
                    + "same exporter the sheet uses, so an agent export and a menu export "
                    + "cannot disagree. An existing file at the path is replaced, and the "
                    + "container's extension is added when the path has none. In an HLG "
                    + "project (set_canvas output) hevc_10bit, av1, av1_webm, vp9_webm, "
                    + "prores_422 and prores_4444 write HLG unless dynamic_range says pq or sdr, and every "
                    + "other video preset writes the project's SDR version. What the finished "
                    + "file holds is export_status's done answer.",
                [
                    "preset": exportPresetProperty,
                    "path": [
                        "type": "string",
                        "description": "Where to write, e.g. ~/Movies/cut.mp4. The folder must "
                            + "exist.",
                    ],
                    "size": exportSizeProperty,
                    "range": [
                        "type": "string",
                        "enum": ["project", "in_out"],
                        "description": "What to write: the whole timeline (default), or just "
                            + "the in/out range set_range set — the sheet's Range popup.",
                    ],
                    "video_bitrate": [
                        "type": "integer", "minimum": 1,
                        "description": "Target video rate in BITS per second (8000000 is "
                            + "8 Mbps) — the sheet's Quality popup. Omit to let the preset's "
                            + "own encoder settings decide. Ignored by presets that carry no "
                            + "rate of their own: ProRes is fixed by its profile, and GIF and "
                            + "APNG have no bitrate at all. On av1 and av1_webm it is a soft "
                            + "cap: SVT-AV1 "
                            + "encodes at a constant quality matched to HEVC at this rate (HEVC's "
                            + "0.07 bits per pixel per frame when omitted), and the file usually "
                            + "stays under it; very detailed footage can go up to about 1.25 "
                            + "times over. On vp9_webm it is a soft cap too: libvpx encodes at a "
                            + "constant quality matched to HEVC at this rate (HEVC 10-bit's in an "
                            + "HDR export), and the file usually stays under it; up to about "
                            + "1.15 times it was measured.",
                    ],
                    "audio_bitrate": [
                        "type": "integer", "minimum": 1,
                        "description": "Target AAC or Opus rate in BITS per second (192000 "
                            + "is 192 kbps) — the sheet's Quality popup. Omit for 192 "
                            + "kbps. Ignored where the sound is neither: ProRes, WAV and AIFF "
                            + "all write LPCM, whose rate is its sample format.",
                    ],
                    "loudness_lufs": [
                        "type": "number", "minimum": -70, "maximum": 0,
                        "description": "Normalise the whole mix to this integrated loudness, "
                            + "in LUFS — the sheet's Loudness popup, whose rows are -14 "
                            + "(streaming), -16 (podcast) and -23 (EBU R 128 broadcast). The "
                            + "export measures itself first and then applies ONE gain to "
                            + "everything, so relative levels inside the timeline are "
                            + "untouched and no limiter is involved. Omit not to normalise: "
                            + "the export still measures and still reports. Ignored where "
                            + "there is no sound to measure (gif, apng).",
                    ],
                    "peak_dbtp": [
                        "type": "number", "minimum": -20, "maximum": 0,
                        "description": "The true-peak ceiling that gain is capped against, in "
                            + "dBTP. The sheet fixes it at -1 and this is the knob for "
                            + "anything else. Because normalisation is gain-only, a ceiling "
                            + "with no loudness_lufs beside it would have nothing to cap and "
                            + "is REFUSED rather than accepted and left inert. When the "
                            + "ceiling bites, the file lands quieter than the target asked "
                            + "for and the result's capped_by_peak says so.",
                    ],
                    "burn_in_timecode": burnInProperty,
                    // The sheet's Dynamic Range popup (spec §11 HD-5, HD-14).
                    "dynamic_range": [
                        "type": "string", "enum": ["hlg", "pq", "sdr"],
                        "description": "An HDR (HLG) project's picture on hevc_10bit, av1, "
                            + "av1_webm, vp9_webm, prores_422 and prores_4444 — the sheet's Dynamic "
                            + "Range popup: hlg (the default; BT.2100 HLG, no Dolby Vision), pq (HDR10: "
                            + "BT.2100 PQ at 1,000 cd/m², mastering display P3-D65 0.005–1,000 "
                            + "cd/m², MaxCLL 1,000, MaxFALL 0) or sdr (the SDR version). Every "
                            + "other video preset writes the SDR version; hlg and pq are refused "
                            + "there and in an SDR project, where sdr changes nothing.",
                    ],
                    // The sheet's Speed popup (spec §11 CX-2, CX-12 (2)).
                    "encoder_speed": [
                        "type": "string", "enum": ["faster", "balanced", "smaller"],
                        "description": "av1's and av1_webm's encoder speed — the sheet's "
                            + "Speed popup: faster "
                            + "(SVT-AV1 preset 8), balanced (preset 6, the default) or smaller "
                            + "(preset 4, the smallest file for the picture and the slowest). "
                            + "Refused on every other preset, vp9_webm included (libvpx has one "
                            + "speed).",
                    ],
                ], required: ["preset", "path"]),
            // Window ▸ Export Queue's row for the job (spec §11 #326).
            tool(
                "export_status",
                "How an export this launch started is going — Window ▸ Export Queue's row "
                    + "for it, read now: it never waits, so call it again after a pause. "
                    + "Always export_id, status (queued, running, done, failed or "
                    + "cancelled), path and elapsed (seconds since export was called, or to "
                    + "the finish once it has finished). running adds progress (0 to 1) and "
                    + "phase while the exporter names one (the loudness measurement). done "
                    + "adds what the file holds: ok, bytes, the settings that were used "
                    + "(preset, container, codec, width, height, fps [num, den], start, "
                    + "duration), burn_in_timecode, dynamic_range in an HLG project (the "
                    + "picture written), encoder_speed on av1 and av1_webm, loudness for "
                    + "every format "
                    + "that carries sound, normalised or not — summary, integrated_lufs, "
                    + "true_peak_dbtp, "
                    + "sample_peak_dbfs, gain_db, ceiling_dbtp, capped_by_peak and target_lufs "
                    + "when one was asked, read off the mix that was written — and "
                    + "graphic_warnings [{name, frame, message}], each distinct warning a "
                    + "graphic gave while the file was drawn, absent when none. failed and "
                    + "cancelled add reason, the queue row's sentence. Only ids export "
                    + "returned are known, until Frame Job quits.",
                [
                    "export_id": [
                        "type": "integer", "minimum": 1,
                        "description": "The export_id export answered.",
                    ]
                ], required: ["export_id"]),
            // The Export Queue row's Cancel (spec §11 #326).
            tool(

        # The 320×180 movie sits unscaled on the 640×360 canvas, a quarter of
        # its area, so a white frame's mean over the whole picture is a
        # quarter of a full one's: the threshold is scaled by the same share.
        flashes = flash_times(out, 128 * FLASH_SHARE)
        result["flashes"] = flashes
        result["flash_frames"] = sorted(round(t * 30) for t in flashes)
        result["expected_frames"] = sorted(round(t * 30) for t in expected)
        av = []
        clicks = [f for f, _ in found if f is not None]
        for t in flashes:
            near = min(clicks, key=lambda c: abs(c - t), default=None)
            if near is not None and abs(near - t) < 0.1:
                av.append((near - t) * 1000)
        result["av_ms"] = av
    _e_cache[key] = result

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Road map "codec-export" C5 — the `vp9_alpha_webm` row: VP9 with alpha in WebM, libvpx's
8-bit Profile 0 picture and a second, frame-aligned libvpx stream of its alpha written as
each video block's BlockAdditional 1 with `AlphaMode` 1 by the core's WebM writer, with Opus
sound, G-35's straight alpha and the alpha rows' shape rule (spec §11 CX-17).

    python3 tools/proof/vp9_alpha_export_proof.py [--app debug|release|PATH]
    python3 tools/proof/vp9_alpha_export_proof.py --probe          # P1 alone, no app
    python3 tools/proof/vp9_alpha_export_proof.py --mutant NAME

Launches its own instances of the chosen app (`proof_app.py`: `--app`, else
`RC_PROOF_APP`, else Debug; a build older than its inputs is refused) on scratch sockets,
works under `tools/proof/work/vp9-alpha-export/`, closes every project it opens with
`discard: true` and stops each instance by its own PID. It reuses `vp9_export_proof.py`'s,
`webm_export_proof.py`'s and `av1_export_proof.py`'s helpers by import (the instance, the
documents, the exports, the ffprobe readers, the EBML walk, the sheet reading, the mutant
builder). ffprobe and ffmpeg (Homebrew, with the `libvpx-vp9` decoder, the only one that
reads a VP9 alpha) only READ the files, and make the DISC source.

The fixtures. "A1's project" is `webm_export_proof.py`'s (AV.mov, 640 × 360, 30 fps, 5 s,
under a two-second text clip, chapter markers "Intro" at 0 s and "Body" at 2.5 s): opaque.

def disc_source(width, height, path):
    """The spike's transparent source (`mkalpha.sh`) at `width` × `height` as ProRes 4444
    with alpha: testsrc2 whose alpha is an opaque disc (radius 300/1080 of the height)
    moving 500/1920 of the width either side of the centre over a 2 s period, over a ramp
    from 0 to 50 % across the width. Made once."""
    path = Path(path)
    if path.exists():
        return path
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    swing, radius = 500 * width / 1920, 300 * height / 1080
    alpha = (f"if(lt(hypot(X-{width / 2}-{swing}*sin(2*PI*T/2),Y-{height / 2}),{radius}),"
             "255,255*X/W*0.5)")
    ran = run(["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-y", "-f", "lavfi", "-i",
               f"testsrc2=s={width}x{height}:r=30:d=2", "-vf",
               f"format=rgba,geq=r='r(X,Y)':g='g(X,Y)':b='b(X,Y)':a='{alpha}'",
               "-c:v", "prores_ks", "-profile:v", "4444", "-pix_fmt", "yuva444p10le",
               "-alpha_bits", "16", str(path)], 600)
    if ran["rc"] != 0 or not path.exists():
        raise RuntimeError(f"the DISC source could not be made: {ran['stderr'][-300:]}")
    return path

# ---- reading the files -------------------------------------------------------------

def probe_alpha(path):
    """ffprobe's format, video and audio streams, with the video's `alpha_mode` tag."""
    ran = run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries",
               "format=format_name,duration:stream=codec_type,codec_name,profile,pix_fmt,"
               "width,height,sample_rate,channels:stream_tags=alpha_mode", "-of", "json",
               path])
    got = json.loads(ran["stdout"] or "{}")
    streams = got.get("streams", [])
    video = next((s for s in streams if s.get("codec_type") == "video"), {})
    audio = next((s for s in streams if s.get("codec_type") == "audio"), {})
    return got.get("format", {}), video, audio, streams


def entry_alpha(path):
    """The video TrackEntry's CodecID, MaxBlockAdditionID and its Video's AlphaMode."""
    data, segment = webm.segment_of(path)
    for entry in webm.track_entries(segment):
        kind = webm.first(entry[4], 0x83)
        if kind and webm.uint(data, kind) == 1:
            codec = webm.first(entry[4], 0x86)
            name = data[codec[2]:codec[2] + codec[3]].decode("latin-1") if codec else None
            most = webm.first(entry[4], 0x55EE)
            video = webm.first(entry[4], 0xE0)
            mode = video and webm.first(video[4], 0x53C0)
            return (name, most and webm.uint(data, most), mode and webm.uint(data, mode),
                    webm.colour_of(data, segment))
    return None, None, None, None


def video_groups(path):
    """The video blocks in file order: [{ms, group, flags, payload, reference, additions}],
    `reference` the ReferenceBlock (signed) or None and `additions` [(BlockAddID, bytes)]."""
    data, segment = webm.segment_of(path)
    out = []
    for cluster in (e for e in (segment[4] if segment else []) if e[0] == 0x1F43B675):
        base = webm.uint(data, webm.first(cluster[4], 0xE7))
        for element in cluster[4]:
            reference, additions = None, []
            if element[0] == 0xA3:
                block = element
            elif element[0] == 0xA0:
                block = webm.first(element[4], 0xA1)
                ref = webm.first(element[4], 0xFB)
                if ref:
                    reference = int.from_bytes(data[ref[2]:ref[2] + ref[3]], "big",
                                               signed=True)
                adds = webm.first(element[4], 0x75A1)
                for more in (e for e in (adds[4] if adds else []) if e[0] == 0xA6):
                    ident, body = webm.first(more[4], 0xEE), webm.first(more[4], 0xA5)
                    additions.append((ident and webm.uint(data, ident),
                                      body and data[body[2]:body[2] + body[3]]))
            else:
                continue
            body = data[block[2]:block[2] + block[3]]
            track, n = webm.vint(body, 0, False)
            if track != 1:
                continue
            out.append({"ms": base + int.from_bytes(body[n:n + 2], "big", signed=True),
                        "group": element[0] == 0xA0, "flags": body[n + 2],
                        "payload": body[n + 3:], "reference": reference,
                        "additions": additions})
    return out


def libvpx(path, *args, seconds=600):
    """ffmpeg reading `path` through the libvpx VP9 decoder (the alpha's only reader)."""
    return subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-c:v", "libvpx-vp9", "-i",
                           str(path), *map(str, args)], capture_output=True, timeout=seconds)


def decoded_format(path, out):
    """The pixel format the libvpx decoder answers, as a rawvideo stream keeps it."""
    nut = out / (Path(path).stem + "-format.nut")
    nut.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    ran = libvpx(path, "-frames:v", "1", "-map", "0:v", "-c:v", "rawvideo", "-y", nut)
    if ran.returncode != 0 or not nut.exists():
        return None
    got = run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "stream=pix_fmt", "-of",
               "csv=p=0", nut])
    nut.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    return got["stdout"].strip() or None


def libvpx_frames(path):
    ran = libvpx(path, "-map", "0:v", "-f", "framecrc", "-")
    if ran.returncode != 0:
        return None
    return sum(1 for line in ran.stdout.decode(errors="replace").splitlines()
               if line.strip() and not line.startswith("#"))


def alpha_planes(path, width, height):
    """The alpha of every frame through libvpx, 8-bit: a list of frames' bytes, or None."""
    ran = libvpx(path, "-vf", "alphaextract", "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "gray", "-")
    size = width * height
    if ran.returncode != 0 or not ran.stdout or len(ran.stdout) % size:
        return None
    return [ran.stdout[k:k + size] for k in range(0, len(ran.stdout), size)]


ROUND16 = None


def reference_alpha(path, width, height):
    """A ProRes 4444 file's alpha per frame, rounded to 8 bits: round(v · 255 / 65535) of
    its 16-bit reading (the decoder's depth widened by bit replication)."""
    global ROUND16
    if ROUND16 is None:
        ROUND16 = bytes((v * 255 + 32767) // 65535 for v in range(65536))
    ran = subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-i", str(path), "-vf",
                          "alphaextract,format=gray16le", "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt",
                          "gray16le", "-"], capture_output=True, timeout=600)
    size = width * height
    if ran.returncode != 0 or not ran.stdout or len(ran.stdout) % (2 * size):
        return None
    words = array("H")
    words.frombytes(ran.stdout)
    if sys.byteorder != "little":
        words.byteswap()
    table = ROUND16
    eight = bytes(table[v] for v in words)
    return [eight[k:k + size] for k in range(0, len(eight), size)]


def psnr(a, b):
    """8-bit PSNR of two frames' bytes; inf when they are equal."""
    if a == b:
        return math.inf
    total = sum((x - y) * (x - y) for x, y in zip(a, b))
    return 10 * math.log10(255 * 255 * len(a) / total)


def rgba_centre(path, width, height, at):
    """The pixel at `at` of frame 15, libvpx-decoded and converted to RGBA through BT.709
    video range."""
    ran = libvpx(path, "-vf", "select=eq(n\\,15),scale=in_color_matrix=bt709:in_range=tv,"
                 "format=rgba", "-frames:v", "1", "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "rgba", "-")
    if ran.returncode != 0 or len(ran.stdout) != width * height * 4:
        return None
    i = (at[1] * width + at[0]) * 4
    return list(ran.stdout[i:i + 4])


def shown_key(payload):
    """`vp9_export_proof.py`'s reading: the payload's first frame is a shown KEY_FRAME."""
    return vp9.shown_key(payload)

def rows_a1_a3(doc, out):
    path = out / "a1.webm"
    try:
        done = export(doc, path)
    except mcp.ToolError as error:
        for ident in ("A1", "A2", "A3", "A5", "A11", "A12"):
            check(ident, False, f"A1's export failed: {error}")
        return None, None
    fmt, video, audio, _ = probe_alpha(path)
    seen = (fmt.get("format_name"), video.get("codec_name"), video.get("profile"),
            video.get("width"), video.get("height"),
            (video.get("tags") or {}).get("alpha_mode"), audio.get("codec_name"))
    want = ("matroska,webm", "vp9", "Profile 0", 640, 360, "1", "opus")
    codec, most, mode, colour = entry_alpha(path)
    want_colour = {"matrix": 1, "bits": 8, "range": 1, "transfer": 1, "primaries": 1,
                   "mastering": False}
    blocks = video_groups(path)
    shapes = [i for i, b in enumerate(blocks)
              if not b["group"] or b["flags"] != 0 or len(b["additions"]) != 1
              or b["additions"][0][0] != 1 or not b["additions"][0][1]]
    references = []
    for i, b in enumerate(blocks):
        key = shown_key(b["payload"])
        want_ref = None if key else (blocks[i - 1]["ms"] - b["ms"] if i else None)
        if key is None or b["reference"] != want_ref or (not key and i == 0):
            references.append((i, b["reference"], want_ref))
    check("A1", done.get("status") == "done" and seen == want and codec == "V_VP9"
          and most == 1 and mode == 1 and colour == want_colour and len(blocks) == FRAMES
          and not shapes and not references,
          f"status {done.get('status')}, {done.get('bytes')} bytes; read {seen} (want {want}); "
          f"walk CodecID {codec!r}, MaxBlockAdditionID {most}, AlphaMode {mode}, Colour "
          f"{colour}; {len(blocks)} video blocks, not a BlockGroup of one BlockAddID 1 with "
          f"flags 0 at {shapes[:6]}; ReferenceBlock wrong at {references[:6]}")

    errors = libvpx(path, "-f", "null", "-")
    lines = [line for line in errors.stderr.decode(errors="replace").splitlines()
             if line.strip()]
    pix = decoded_format(path, out)
    frames = libvpx_frames(path)
    samples = webm.audio_samples(path)
    check("A2", errors.returncode == 0 and not lines and pix == "yuva420p"
          and frames == FRAMES and samples == SAMPLES,
          f"libvpx-vp9 rc {errors.returncode}, {len(lines)} lines {lines[:2]}; decoded as "
          f"{pix} (want yuva420p); {frames} frames (want {FRAMES}); {samples} audio samples "
          f"(want {SAMPLES})")

    keys = [i for i, b in enumerate(blocks) if b["reference"] is None]
    want_keys = list(range(0, len(blocks), KEY_INTERVAL))
    alpha_keys = [i for i, b in enumerate(blocks)
                  if b["additions"] and shown_key(b["additions"][0][1]) != (b["reference"] is None)]
    check("A3", blocks and keys == want_keys and not alpha_keys,
          f"key blocks (no ReferenceBlock) {keys} (want every {KEY_INTERVAL} from 0: "
          f"{want_keys}); an alpha payload's KEY_FRAME disagreeing with its block at "
          f"{alpha_keys[:6]}")
    return path, done


def row_a4(instance, out):
    lines, ok = [], True
    cases = [("DISC 640×360", lambda: disc_doc(instance, "a4-disc360", 640, 360), 640, 360),
             ("DISC 1080p", lambda: disc_doc(instance, "a4-disc1080", 1920, 1080), 1920, 1080),
             ("TITLE", lambda: title_doc(instance, "a4-title"), 1920, 1080)]
    for label, make, width, height in cases:
        doc = None
        try:
            doc = make()
            tag = label.split()[0].lower() + str(width)
            master = out / f"a4-{tag}-prores_4444.mov"
            export(doc, master, preset="prores_4444")
            reference = reference_alpha(master, width, height)
            if reference is None:
                ok = False
                lines.append(f"{label}: the ProRes 4444 alpha could not be read ✗")
                continue
            for tier in TIERS:
                path = out / f"a4-{tag}-{tier}.webm"
                export(doc, path, video_bitrate=tier_rate(width, height, tier))
                planes = alpha_planes(path, width, height)
                if planes is None or len(planes) != len(reference):
                    ok = False
                    lines.append(f"{label} {tier}: {None if planes is None else len(planes)} "
                                 f"alpha frames against {len(reference)} ✗")
                    continue
                scores = [psnr(a, b) for a, b in zip(planes, reference)]
                worst = min(scores)
                where = scores.index(worst)
                good = worst >= PSNR_FLOOR
                ok = ok and good

def cancel_while_encoding(doc, job, path):
    """`vp9_export_proof.py` V6's reading: wait past the loudness measurement until the
    writer's progress moves, cancel, and time the stop."""
    import time
    progress, status, measured, floor = 0, {}, None, None
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 300
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        status = doc.client.call("export_status", export_id=job)
        progress = status.get("progress") or 0
        if status.get("status") in ("done", "failed", "cancelled"):
            break
        if status.get("phase"):
            measured = max(measured or 0, progress)
        elif status.get("status") == "running" and measured is not None:
            if floor is None:
                floor = progress
            elif progress > floor:
                break
        time.sleep(0.05)
    if status.get("status") != "running":
        return False, f"never running past the measurement with progress above it: {status}"
    asked = time.monotonic()
    doc.client.call("cancel_export", export_id=job)
    final = {}
    while time.monotonic() - asked < 600:
        final = doc.client.call("export_status", export_id=job)
        if final.get("status") in ("done", "failed", "cancelled"):
            break
        time.sleep(0.05)
    took = time.monotonic() - asked
    exists = path.exists()
    ok = final.get("status") == "cancelled" and took <= vp9.CANCEL_BOUND and not exists
    return ok, (f"cancelled while encoding at progress {progress:.4f} (the writer started at "
                f"{floor}); status {final.get('status')!r} {took:.2f} s after cancel_export "
                f"(≤ {vp9.CANCEL_BOUND}); a file at the path: {exists}")

P1_PAIRS = [[k, k in (0, 3), [0x50, k], [0xA1, k]] for k in range(4)]
P1_PTS = "libvpx's alpha stream answered frame 2 where the picture's answered 1."
P1_KEY = "libvpx's alpha frame 1 and picture frame 1 disagree on being a keyframe."
P1_ENDED = "libvpx's picture answered frame 1 after the other stream ended."
P1_INTERVALS = {"24": 48, "29.97": 59, "30": 60, "60": 120}


def run_probe(sources=ROOT / SOURCES):
    import reference_build
    import swift_build
    out = WORK / ("probe" if Path(sources).resolve() == (ROOT / SOURCES).resolve()
                  else "probe-mutant")
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    entry = out / "main.swift"
    text = (HERE / "vp9_alpha_probe.swift").read_text()
    if not entry.exists() or entry.read_text() != text:
        entry.write_text(text)
    binary, answer = out / "vp9-alpha-probe", out / "answer.json"
    defines = reference_build.tree_defines(Path(sources).parent.parent, ["FRAMEJOB_DEV_TOOLS"])
    try:
        built = swift_build.build(sources=swift_build.app_sources(sources) + [entry],
                                  output=binary, defines=defines)
        if not built.reused:
            print(f"probe built in {built.seconds:.0f} s", flush=True)
    except swift_build.SwiftBuildFailed as error:
        lines = [line for line in error.diagnostics if ": error:" in line]
        return check("P1", False, "the probe did not build: "
                     + " | ".join(lines[:3] or list(error.diagnostics[:3]) or [str(error)]))
    answer.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    ran = bounded.run([str(binary), str(answer)], 120)
    if ran["expired"] or ran["rc"] != 0 or not answer.exists():
        return check("P1", False, "the probe did not run: "
                     + (ran["stdout"] + ran["stderr"]).strip()[-300:])
    got = json.loads(answer.read_text())
    misses = []
    matched = got.get("matched", {})
    if matched.get("pairs") != P1_PAIRS or matched.get("error") != "no error":
        misses.append(f"matched {matched}")
    if got.get("pts") != P1_PTS or got.get("pts_pairs") != 1:
        misses.append(f"pts {got.get('pts')!r} after {got.get('pts_pairs')} pairs")
    if got.get("key") != P1_KEY or got.get("key_pairs") != 1:
        misses.append(f"key {got.get('key')!r} after {got.get('key_pairs')} pairs")
    if got.get("ended") != P1_ENDED:
        misses.append(f"ended {got.get('ended')!r}")
    if got.get("intervals") != P1_INTERVALS:
        misses.append(f"intervals {got.get('intervals')} (want {P1_INTERVALS})")
    check("P1", not misses, "four matched pairs; the pts, key and ended sentences; the key "
          "intervals at 24, 29.97, 30 and 60 fps: "
          + (f"misses {misses}" if misses else "every answer the expected one"))

def run_mutant(name):
    if name not in MUTANTS:
        print(f"unknown mutant {name}; the mutants are {sorted(MUTANTS)}")
        return 2
    mutant = MUTANTS[name]
    named = list(mutant["rows"])
    print(f"mutant {name}: building the copy", flush=True)
    av1.MUTANTS = MUTANTS
    app, copy = av1.build_mutant(name)
    if app is None:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {copy}")
        return 2
    cargo = mutant.get("cargo")
    if cargo:
        ran = bounded.run(["cargo", "test", "--release", "--no-fail-fast", "--test", cargo],
                          1200, cwd=str(copy / "core"))
        out = ran["stdout"] + ran["stderr"]
        if ran["expired"] or "test result:" not in out:
            print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — cargo rc {ran['rc']}: "
                  f"{out[-600:]}")
            return 2
        failed = re.findall(r"^test (\w+) \.\.\. FAILED$", out, re.M)
        check(f"cargo-{cargo}", ran["rc"] == 0, f"failed tests {failed}")
        named.append(f"cargo-{cargo}")
    logs = []
    try:
        run_rows(app, logs, probe=False)
    except Exception as error:  # an instrument that cannot run is the control's failure
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {error}")
        return 2

    print(f"mutant {name}: named {sorted(named)}, failing {failing}")
    if sorted(named) == failing:
        print(f"MUTANT CAUGHT: {name}")
        return 1
    if not set(named) & set(failing):
        print(f"MUTANT SURVIVED: {name}")
        return 0
    print(f"MUTANT CAUGHT, NOT EXACTLY: {name}")
    return 3


# ---- main --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def run_rows(app, logs, probe=True):
    run_a_rows(app, logs)
    run_s1(app, logs)
    if probe:
        run_probe()
    found = [(i.label, line) for i in logs for line in i.complaints()]
    check("Z1", not found, f"{len(logs)} instance logs; complaints {found[:4]}")


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="the vp9_alpha_webm row (codec-export C5)")
    parser.add_argument("--app", help="debug, release or a .app path (default RC_PROOF_APP)")
    parser.add_argument("--probe", action="store_true", help="P1 alone, no app")
    parser.add_argument("--mutant", help="one of " + ", ".join(MUTANTS))
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Road map "codec-export" C5 — the `vp9_alpha_webm` row: VP9 with alpha in WebM, libvpx's
8-bit Profile 0 picture and a second, frame-aligned libvpx stream of its alpha written as
each video block's BlockAdditional 1 with `AlphaMode` 1 by the core's WebM writer, with Opus
sound, G-35's straight alpha and the alpha rows' shape rule (spec §11 CX-17).

    python3 tools/proof/vp9_alpha_export_proof.py [--app debug|release|PATH]
    python3 tools/proof/vp9_alpha_export_proof.py --probe          # P1 alone, no app
    python3 tools/proof/vp9_alpha_export_proof.py --mutant NAME

Launches its own instances of the chosen app (`proof_app.py`: `--app`, else
`RC_PROOF_APP`, else Debug; a build older than its inputs is refused) on scratch sockets,
works under `tools/proof/work/vp9-alpha-export/`, closes every project it opens with
`discard: true` and stops each instance by its own PID. It reuses `vp9_export_proof.py`'s,
`webm_export_proof.py`'s and `av1_export_proof.py`'s helpers by import (the instance, the
documents, the exports, the ffprobe readers, the EBML walk, the sheet reading, the mutant
builder). ffprobe and ffmpeg (Homebrew, with the `libvpx-vp9` decoder, the only one that
reads a VP9 alpha) only READ the files, and make the DISC source.

The fixtures. "A1's project" is `webm_export_proof.py`'s (AV.mov, 640 × 360, 30 fps, 5 s,
under a two-second text clip, chapter markers "Intro" at 0 s and "Body" at 2.5 s): opaque.

def disc_source(width, height, path):
    """The spike's transparent source (`mkalpha.sh`) at `width` × `height` as ProRes 4444
    with alpha: testsrc2 whose alpha is an opaque disc (radius 300/1080 of the height)
    moving 500/1920 of the width either side of the centre over a 2 s period, over a ramp
    from 0 to 50 % across the width. Made once."""
    path = Path(path)
    if path.exists():
        return path
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    swing, radius = 500 * width / 1920, 300 * height / 1080
    alpha = (f"if(lt(hypot(X-{width / 2}-{swing}*sin(2*PI*T/2),Y-{height / 2}),{radius}),"
             "255,255*X/W*0.5)")
    ran = run(["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-y", "-f", "lavfi", "-i",
               f"testsrc2=s={width}x{height}:r=30:d=2", "-vf",
               f"format=rgba,geq=r='r(X,Y)':g='g(X,Y)':b='b(X,Y)':a='{alpha}'",
               "-c:v", "prores_ks", "-profile:v", "4444", "-pix_fmt", "yuva444p10le",
               "-alpha_bits", "16", str(path)], 600)
    if ran["rc"] != 0 or not path.exists():
        raise RuntimeError(f"the DISC source could not be made: {ran['stderr'][-300:]}")
    return path

# ---- reading the files -------------------------------------------------------------

def probe_alpha(path):
    """ffprobe's format, video and audio streams, with the video's `alpha_mode` tag."""
    ran = run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries",
               "format=format_name,duration:stream=codec_type,codec_name,profile,pix_fmt,"
               "width,height,sample_rate,channels:stream_tags=alpha_mode", "-of", "json",
               path])
    got = json.loads(ran["stdout"] or "{}")
    streams = got.get("streams", [])
    video = next((s for s in streams if s.get("codec_type") == "video"), {})
    audio = next((s for s in streams if s.get("codec_type") == "audio"), {})
    return got.get("format", {}), video, audio, streams


def entry_alpha(path):
    """The video TrackEntry's CodecID, MaxBlockAdditionID and its Video's AlphaMode."""
    data, segment = webm.segment_of(path)
    for entry in webm.track_entries(segment):
        kind = webm.first(entry[4], 0x83)
        if kind and webm.uint(data, kind) == 1:
            codec = webm.first(entry[4], 0x86)
            name = data[codec[2]:codec[2] + codec[3]].decode("latin-1") if codec else None
            most = webm.first(entry[4], 0x55EE)
            video = webm.first(entry[4], 0xE0)
            mode = video and webm.first(video[4], 0x53C0)
            return (name, most and webm.uint(data, most), mode and webm.uint(data, mode),
                    webm.colour_of(data, segment))
    return None, None, None, None


def video_groups(path):
    """The video blocks in file order: [{ms, group, flags, payload, reference, additions}],
    `reference` the ReferenceBlock (signed) or None and `additions` [(BlockAddID, bytes)]."""
    data, segment = webm.segment_of(path)
    out = []
    for cluster in (e for e in (segment[4] if segment else []) if e[0] == 0x1F43B675):
        base = webm.uint(data, webm.first(cluster[4], 0xE7))
        for element in cluster[4]:
            reference, additions = None, []
            if element[0] == 0xA3:
                block = element
            elif element[0] == 0xA0:
                block = webm.first(element[4], 0xA1)
                ref = webm.first(element[4], 0xFB)
                if ref:
                    reference = int.from_bytes(data[ref[2]:ref[2] + ref[3]], "big",
                                               signed=True)
                adds = webm.first(element[4], 0x75A1)
                for more in (e for e in (adds[4] if adds else []) if e[0] == 0xA6):
                    ident, body = webm.first(more[4], 0xEE), webm.first(more[4], 0xA5)
                    additions.append((ident and webm.uint(data, ident),
                                      body and data[body[2]:body[2] + body[3]]))
            else:
                continue
            body = data[block[2]:block[2] + block[3]]
            track, n = webm.vint(body, 0, False)
            if track != 1:
                continue
            out.append({"ms": base + int.from_bytes(body[n:n + 2], "big", signed=True),
                        "group": element[0] == 0xA0, "flags": body[n + 2],
                        "payload": body[n + 3:], "reference": reference,
                        "additions": additions})
    return out


def libvpx(path, *args, seconds=600):
    """ffmpeg reading `path` through the libvpx VP9 decoder (the alpha's only reader)."""
    return subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-c:v", "libvpx-vp9", "-i",
                           str(path), *map(str, args)], capture_output=True, timeout=seconds)


def decoded_format(path, out):
    """The pixel format the libvpx decoder answers, as a rawvideo stream keeps it."""
    nut = out / (Path(path).stem + "-format.nut")
    nut.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    ran = libvpx(path, "-frames:v", "1", "-map", "0:v", "-c:v", "rawvideo", "-y", nut)
    if ran.returncode != 0 or not nut.exists():
        return None
    got = run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "stream=pix_fmt", "-of",
               "csv=p=0", nut])
    nut.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    return got["stdout"].strip() or None


def libvpx_frames(path):
    ran = libvpx(path, "-map", "0:v", "-f", "framecrc", "-")
    if ran.returncode != 0:
        return None
    return sum(1 for line in ran.stdout.decode(errors="replace").splitlines()
               if line.strip() and not line.startswith("#"))


def alpha_planes(path, width, height):
    """The alpha of every frame through libvpx, 8-bit: a list of frames' bytes, or None."""
    ran = libvpx(path, "-vf", "alphaextract", "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "gray", "-")
    size = width * height
    if ran.returncode != 0 or not ran.stdout or len(ran.stdout) % size:
        return None
    return [ran.stdout[k:k + size] for k in range(0, len(ran.stdout), size)]


ROUND16 = None


def reference_alpha(path, width, height):
    """A ProRes 4444 file's alpha per frame, rounded to 8 bits: round(v · 255 / 65535) of
    its 16-bit reading (the decoder's depth widened by bit replication)."""
    global ROUND16
    if ROUND16 is None:
        ROUND16 = bytes((v * 255 + 32767) // 65535 for v in range(65536))
    ran = subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-i", str(path), "-vf",
                          "alphaextract,format=gray16le", "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt",
                          "gray16le", "-"], capture_output=True, timeout=600)
    size = width * height
    if ran.returncode != 0 or not ran.stdout or len(ran.stdout) % (2 * size):
        return None
    words = array("H")
    words.frombytes(ran.stdout)
    if sys.byteorder != "little":
        words.byteswap()
    table = ROUND16
    eight = bytes(table[v] for v in words)
    return [eight[k:k + size] for k in range(0, len(eight), size)]


def psnr(a, b):
    """8-bit PSNR of two frames' bytes; inf when they are equal."""
    if a == b:
        return math.inf
    total = sum((x - y) * (x - y) for x, y in zip(a, b))
    return 10 * math.log10(255 * 255 * len(a) / total)


def rgba_centre(path, width, height, at):
    """The pixel at `at` of frame 15, libvpx-decoded and converted to RGBA through BT.709
    video range."""
    ran = libvpx(path, "-vf", "select=eq(n\\,15),scale=in_color_matrix=bt709:in_range=tv,"
                 "format=rgba", "-frames:v", "1", "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "rgba", "-")
    if ran.returncode != 0 or len(ran.stdout) != width * height * 4:
        return None
    i = (at[1] * width + at[0]) * 4
    return list(ran.stdout[i:i + 4])


def shown_key(payload):
    """`vp9_export_proof.py`'s reading: the payload's first frame is a shown KEY_FRAME."""
    return vp9.shown_key(payload)

def rows_a1_a3(doc, out):
    path = out / "a1.webm"
    try:
        done = export(doc, path)
    except mcp.ToolError as error:
        for ident in ("A1", "A2", "A3", "A5", "A11", "A12"):
            check(ident, False, f"A1's export failed: {error}")
        return None, None
    fmt, video, audio, _ = probe_alpha(path)
    seen = (fmt.get("format_name"), video.get("codec_name"), video.get("profile"),
            video.get("width"), video.get("height"),
            (video.get("tags") or {}).get("alpha_mode"), audio.get("codec_name"))
    want = ("matroska,webm", "vp9", "Profile 0", 640, 360, "1", "opus")
    codec, most, mode, colour = entry_alpha(path)
    want_colour = {"matrix": 1, "bits": 8, "range": 1, "transfer": 1, "primaries": 1,
                   "mastering": False}
    blocks = video_groups(path)
    shapes = [i for i, b in enumerate(blocks)
              if not b["group"] or b["flags"] != 0 or len(b["additions"]) != 1
              or b["additions"][0][0] != 1 or not b["additions"][0][1]]
    references = []
    for i, b in enumerate(blocks):
        key = shown_key(b["payload"])
        want_ref = None if key else (blocks[i - 1]["ms"] - b["ms"] if i else None)
        if key is None or b["reference"] != want_ref or (not key and i == 0):
            references.append((i, b["reference"], want_ref))
    check("A1", done.get("status") == "done" and seen == want and codec == "V_VP9"
          and most == 1 and mode == 1 and colour == want_colour and len(blocks) == FRAMES
          and not shapes and not references,
          f"status {done.get('status')}, {done.get('bytes')} bytes; read {seen} (want {want}); "
          f"walk CodecID {codec!r}, MaxBlockAdditionID {most}, AlphaMode {mode}, Colour "
          f"{colour}; {len(blocks)} video blocks, not a BlockGroup of one BlockAddID 1 with "
          f"flags 0 at {shapes[:6]}; ReferenceBlock wrong at {references[:6]}")

    errors = libvpx(path, "-f", "null", "-")
    lines = [line for line in errors.stderr.decode(errors="replace").splitlines()
             if line.strip()]
    pix = decoded_format(path, out)
    frames = libvpx_frames(path)
    samples = webm.audio_samples(path)
    check("A2", errors.returncode == 0 and not lines and pix == "yuva420p"
          and frames == FRAMES and samples == SAMPLES,
          f"libvpx-vp9 rc {errors.returncode}, {len(lines)} lines {lines[:2]}; decoded as "
          f"{pix} (want yuva420p); {frames} frames (want {FRAMES}); {samples} audio samples "
          f"(want {SAMPLES})")

    keys = [i for i, b in enumerate(blocks) if b["reference"] is None]
    want_keys = list(range(0, len(blocks), KEY_INTERVAL))
    alpha_keys = [i for i, b in enumerate(blocks)
                  if b["additions"] and shown_key(b["additions"][0][1]) != (b["reference"] is None)]
    check("A3", blocks and keys == want_keys and not alpha_keys,
          f"key blocks (no ReferenceBlock) {keys} (want every {KEY_INTERVAL} from 0: "
          f"{want_keys}); an alpha payload's KEY_FRAME disagreeing with its block at "
          f"{alpha_keys[:6]}")
    return path, done


def row_a4(instance, out):
    lines, ok = [], True
    cases = [("DISC 640×360", lambda: disc_doc(instance, "a4-disc360", 640, 360), 640, 360),
             ("DISC 1080p", lambda: disc_doc(instance, "a4-disc1080", 1920, 1080), 1920, 1080),
             ("TITLE", lambda: title_doc(instance, "a4-title"), 1920, 1080)]
    for label, make, width, height in cases:
        doc = None
        try:
            doc = make()
            tag = label.split()[0].lower() + str(width)
            master = out / f"a4-{tag}-prores_4444.mov"
            export(doc, master, preset="prores_4444")
            reference = reference_alpha(master, width, height)
            if reference is None:
                ok = False
                lines.append(f"{label}: the ProRes 4444 alpha could not be read ✗")
                continue
            for tier in TIERS:
                path = out / f"a4-{tag}-{tier}.webm"
                export(doc, path, video_bitrate=tier_rate(width, height, tier))
                planes = alpha_planes(path, width, height)
                if planes is None or len(planes) != len(reference):
                    ok = False
                    lines.append(f"{label} {tier}: {None if planes is None else len(planes)} "
                                 f"alpha frames against {len(reference)} ✗")
                    continue
                scores = [psnr(a, b) for a, b in zip(planes, reference)]
                worst = min(scores)
                where = scores.index(worst)
                good = worst >= PSNR_FLOOR
                ok = ok and good
                finite = [s for s in scores if math.isfinite(s)]
                mean = sum(finite) / len(finite) if finite else math.inf
                lines.append(f"{label} {tier}: worst {worst:.2f} dB at frame {where}, mean of "

def cancel_while_encoding(doc, job, path):
    """`vp9_export_proof.py` V6's reading: wait past the loudness measurement until the
    writer's progress moves, cancel, and time the stop."""
    import time
    progress, status, measured, floor = 0, {}, None, None
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 300
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        status = doc.client.call("export_status", export_id=job)
        progress = status.get("progress") or 0
        if status.get("status") in ("done", "failed", "cancelled"):
            break
        if status.get("phase"):
            measured = max(measured or 0, progress)
        elif status.get("status") == "running" and measured is not None:
            if floor is None:
                floor = progress
            elif progress > floor:
                break
        time.sleep(0.05)
    if status.get("status") != "running":
        return False, f"never running past the measurement with progress above it: {status}"
    asked = time.monotonic()
    doc.client.call("cancel_export", export_id=job)
    final = {}
    while time.monotonic() - asked < 600:
        final = doc.client.call("export_status", export_id=job)
        if final.get("status") in ("done", "failed", "cancelled"):
            break
        time.sleep(0.05)
    took = time.monotonic() - asked
    exists = path.exists()
    ok = final.get("status") == "cancelled" and took <= vp9.CANCEL_BOUND and not exists
    return ok, (f"cancelled while encoding at progress {progress:.4f} (the writer started at "
                f"{floor}); status {final.get('status')!r} {took:.2f} s after cancel_export "
                f"(≤ {vp9.CANCEL_BOUND}); a file at the path: {exists}")

    def lighter(dark):

    check("S1", not reading.get("error") and reading.get("format") == "VP9 with Alpha (WebM)"
          and speed is not None and speed > 60 and dynamic is not None and dynamic > 60
          and reading.get("range") == "SDR version" and named,
          f"{reading.get('error') or ''} format {reading.get('format')!r}; Speed "
          f"{reading.get('speed')!r} {speed} levels lighter than Format, Dynamic Range "
          f"{reading.get('range')!r} {dynamic} (> 60 is disabled); footnote "
          f"{reading.get('footnote')}")


# ---- the probe (P1) ----------------------------------------------------------------

P1_PAIRS = [[k, k in (0, 3), [0x50, k], [0xA1, k]] for k in range(4)]
P1_PTS = "libvpx's alpha stream answered frame 2 where the picture's answered 1."
P1_KEY = "libvpx's alpha frame 1 and picture frame 1 disagree on being a keyframe."
P1_ENDED = "libvpx's picture answered frame 1 after the other stream ended."
P1_INTERVALS = {"24": 48, "29.97": 59, "30": 60, "60": 120}


def run_probe(sources=ROOT / SOURCES):
    import reference_build
    import swift_build
    out = WORK / ("probe" if Path(sources).resolve() == (ROOT / SOURCES).resolve()
                  else "probe-mutant")
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    entry = out / "main.swift"
    text = (HERE / "vp9_alpha_probe.swift").read_text()
    if not entry.exists() or entry.read_text() != text:
        entry.write_text(text)
    binary, answer = out / "vp9-alpha-probe", out / "answer.json"
    defines = reference_build.tree_defines(Path(sources).parent.parent, ["FRAMEJOB_DEV_TOOLS"])
    try:
        built = swift_build.build(sources=swift_build.app_sources(sources) + [entry],
                                  output=binary, defines=defines)
        if not built.reused:
            print(f"probe built in {built.seconds:.0f} s", flush=True)
    except swift_build.SwiftBuildFailed as error:
        lines = [line for line in error.diagnostics if ": error:" in line]
        return check("P1", False, "the probe did not build: "
                     + " | ".join(lines[:3] or list(error.diagnostics[:3]) or [str(error)]))
    answer.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    ran = bounded.run([str(binary), str(answer)], 120)
    if ran["expired"] or ran["rc"] != 0 or not answer.exists():
        return check("P1", False, "the probe did not run: "
                     + (ran["stdout"] + ran["stderr"]).strip()[-300:])
    got = json.loads(answer.read_text())
    misses = []
    matched = got.get("matched", {})
    if matched.get("pairs") != P1_PAIRS or matched.get("error") != "no error":
        misses.append(f"matched {matched}")
    if got.get("pts") != P1_PTS or got.get("pts_pairs") != 1:
        misses.append(f"pts {got.get('pts')!r} after {got.get('pts_pairs')} pairs")
    if got.get("key") != P1_KEY or got.get("key_pairs") != 1:
        misses.append(f"key {got.get('key')!r} after {got.get('key_pairs')} pairs")
    if got.get("ended") != P1_ENDED:
        misses.append(f"ended {got.get('ended')!r}")
    if got.get("intervals") != P1_INTERVALS:
        misses.append(f"intervals {got.get('intervals')} (want {P1_INTERVALS})")
    check("P1", not misses, "four matched pairs; the pts, key and ended sentences; the key "
          "intervals at 24, 29.97, 30 and 60 fps: "
          + (f"misses {misses}" if misses else "every answer the expected one"))


# ---- the mutants -------------------------------------------------------------------

def run_mutant(name):
    if name not in MUTANTS:
        print(f"unknown mutant {name}; the mutants are {sorted(MUTANTS)}")
        return 2
    mutant = MUTANTS[name]
    named = list(mutant["rows"])
    print(f"mutant {name}: building the copy", flush=True)
    av1.MUTANTS = MUTANTS
    app, copy = av1.build_mutant(name)
    if app is None:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {copy}")
        return 2
    cargo = mutant.get("cargo")
    if cargo:
        ran = bounded.run(["cargo", "test", "--release", "--no-fail-fast", "--test", cargo],
                          1200, cwd=str(copy / "core"))
        out = ran["stdout"] + ran["stderr"]
        if ran["expired"] or "test result:" not in out:
            print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — cargo rc {ran['rc']}: "
                  f"{out[-600:]}")
            return 2
        failed = re.findall(r"^test (\w+) \.\.\. FAILED$", out, re.M)
        check(f"cargo-{cargo}", ran["rc"] == 0, f"failed tests {failed}")
        named.append(f"cargo-{cargo}")
    logs = []
    try:
        run_rows(app, logs, probe=False)
    except Exception as error:  # an instrument that cannot run is the control's failure
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {error}")
        return 2
    failing = sorted(k for k, v in results.items() if not v)
    print(f"mutant {name}: named {sorted(named)}, failing {failing}")
    if sorted(named) == failing:
        print(f"MUTANT CAUGHT: {name}")
        return 1
    if not set(named) & set(failing):
        print(f"MUTANT SURVIVED: {name}")
        return 0
    print(f"MUTANT CAUGHT, NOT EXACTLY: {name}")
    return 3


# ---- main --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def run_rows(app, logs, probe=True):
    run_a_rows(app, logs)
    run_s1(app, logs)
    if probe:
        run_probe()
    found = [(i.label, line) for i in logs for line in i.complaints()]
    check("Z1", not found, f"{len(logs)} instance logs; complaints {found[:4]}")


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="the vp9_alpha_webm row (codec-export C5)")
    parser.add_argument("--app", help="debug, release or a .app path (default RC_PROOF_APP)")
    parser.add_argument("--probe", action="store_true", help="P1 alone, no app")
    parser.add_argument("--mutant", help="one of " + ", ".join(MUTANTS))
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.app:
        os.environ[proof_app.ENV] = args.app
    WORK.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if args.mutant:
        return run_mutant(args.mutant)
    if args.probe:
        run_probe()
        print(f"scores: {sum(results.values())}/{len(results)}")
        return 0 if all(results.values()) else 1
    logs = []
    try:
        app = proof_app.bundle()
        proof_app.require_fresh(proof_app.executable(app))
    except (proof_app.StaleApp, ValueError, OSError) as error:
        check("A0", False, f"the app cannot be driven: {error}")
        print("scores: 0/1")
        return 1
    print(f"app {app}", flush=True)
    run_rows(app, logs)
    passed = sum(results.values())
    print(f"scores: {passed}/{len(results)}")
    return 0 if all(results.values()) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
